user_query: I'm interested in learning about the environmental impact of different types of paper. Can you provide me with the carbon footprint equivalent of different paper weights? Additionally, suggest eco-friendly alternatives to traditional paper products. Also, give me the nutritional analysis for each recipe and suggest eco-friendly alternatives for common ingredients.

TaskList.description: Research and compile data on the carbon footprint associated with different paper weights.
Find and list eco-friendly alternatives to traditional paper products.
Gather nutritional analysis for each recipe mentioned by the user.
Research and provide eco-friendly alternatives for common cooking ingredients used in the recipes.
